parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parame.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parame.command: set interfaces ge-0/1/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.10.1.1/24
set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parame.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set protocols bgp [parameter1] neighbor.explanation: 配置BGP协议的邻居及其远程AS号。

set protocols bgp [parameter1] address-f.template: set protocols bgp [parameter1] address-family ipv4-unicast neighbor [parameter2] activate
set protocols bgp [parameter1] address-f.command: set protocols bgp 100 address-family ipv4-unicast neighbor 10.10.1.2 activate
set protocols bgp [parameter1] address-f.explanation: 激活BGP邻居的IPv4单播地址族。

set protocols bgp [parameter1] address-f.template: set protocols bgp [parameter1] address-family ipv4-unicast synchronization disable
set protocols bgp [parameter1] address-f.command: set protocols bgp 100 address-family ipv4-unicast synchronization disable
set protocols bgp [parameter1] address-f.explanation: 禁用BGP的IPv4单播地址族的同步功能。
